name: visual-explained-stack
description: The login form goes from one row to a stacked column, and its Playwright baseline changes with it. Nothing to report as a finding: a clean control that carries a screenshot, so images cannot buy an invented finding. The screenshot line must name the stacking and tie it to login.css.

expected_visual.why: The visible change is the fields and the button moving from one row into a column.
The point of the line: the PR's own CSS explains the new baseline.
